sources.title: GitHub - MiniMax-AI/MiniMax-Music3
sources.snippet: MiniMax Music 3 MiniMax Music 3 is a high-performance music generation model for creating complete songs up to five minutes long. Conditioned on lyrics and a detailed music description, it generates structurally coherent songs with expressive vocals, evolving arrangements, and stable long-form audio quality.

sources.snippet: The MiniMax Music 3 system is built upon a Hybrid-LM architecture that bifurcates music generation into global structural modeling and local acoustic refinement. This hierarchical approach allows the model to maintain long-range coherence for songs up to five minutes in length while preserving high-fidelity stereo audio quality README.md18-23
